class.name: AudioStreamMIDI
class.brief_description: Plays a Standard MIDI File through OPL3 FM synthesis.
class.description: An [AudioStream] that plays a Standard MIDI File through libADLMIDI's OPL3 FM synthesizer emulation, using libADLMIDI's built-in sequencer to interpret the song. It loads automatically when you [method @GlobalScope.load] a [code].mid[/code], [code].midi[/code], [code].rmi[/code], [code].xmi[/code], or [code].kar[/code] file, or can be built in code by assigning raw file bytes to [member midi_data]. The resource is read-only apart from its data; it exposes metadata ([member title], [member copyright], [member track_count], [member songs_count], [method get_loop_start_time], ...). Beyond the synthesizer parameters inherited from [AudioStreamMIDIBase], it adds these [AudioStreamPlayer] parameters, read when playback starts: - [code]song_number[/code] (int): which song to play in a multi-song file (typically XMI); [code]-1[/code] mixes every song's tracks together. - [code]loop_enabled[/code] (bool): if [code]true[/code], loops using the file's [code]loopStart[/code]/[code]loopEnd[/code] tags, if present. - [code]loop_count[/code] (int): times to loop when looping is enabled; [code]-1[/code] loops forever. Multiple [AudioStreamPlayer]s can play the same [AudioStreamMIDI] resource at once; each playback gets its own independent synthesizer state.

method.name: get_bank_count
method.description: Returns the number of instrument banks built into libADLMIDI, for use with [member AudioStreamMIDIBase.embedded_bank].

method.name: get_bank_name
method.description: Returns the display name of the built-in instrument bank at [param index].

method.name: get_copyright
method.description: Returns the copyright notice embedded in the loaded MIDI file, or an empty string if it has none.

method.name: get_loop_end_time
method.description: Returns the loop end position in seconds, or [code]-1[/code] if the file has no [code]loopEnd[/code] tag.

method.name: get_loop_start_time
method.description: Returns the loop start position in seconds, or [code]-1[/code] if the file has no [code]loopStart[/code] tag.

method.name: get_songs_count
method.description: Returns the number of songs in the loaded file. Files with more than one song (typically XMI) can be switched between with the [code]song_number[/code] parameter.

method.name: get_title
method.description: Returns the title embedded in the loaded MIDI file, or an empty string if it has none.

method.name: get_track_count
method.description: Returns the number of tracks in the loaded MIDI file.

method.name: get_track_title
method.description: Returns the title of the track at [param index].

members.member: Copyright text from the MIDI file. Read-only.
Raw bytes of the Standard MIDI File to play. Set automatically when loading a [code].mid[/code] file; can also be assigned directly.
Number of songs in the loaded file. Read-only.
Music title from the MIDI file. Read-only.
Number of tracks in the loaded file. Read-only.
